action: Compared the owner's liked starter hull with the rejected Lark close view, then traced Lark's Forge UV projection, material bindings, runtime route and shared texture payloads.
observation: The starter uses a detailed trim atlas; Lark's Hull, Armor and Accent share a near-white repeating Forge atlas used by many other models. The main Lark hull UVs cover roughly 4.65 by 1.89 tiles. The user explicitly prefers the detailed starter finish and rejects Lark's flat/cartoon surface.
decision: Explore Lark-only surface changes without replacing the shared atlas or altering shape, tints, motion and sockets.
next: Preview a generated candidate under the current renderer and compare game and close distances.
evidenceScope: Owner-directed visual comparison and static route/material analysis; no new player-route run or runtime asset mutation.
performance: Avoiding a shared atlas replacement protects 159 other packaged assets; no frame-time result.

action: Inspected a generated Lark-only panel map, measured its repeating boundary and luminance against the original, and fed the seam and color risks back to the asset worker.
observation: The initial image retained broad panel placement and added painted detail, but the opposite-edge mismatch and lower mean brightness made wrapping and cream/teal identity uncertain. This was an image-space diagnostic, not proof of a visible seam.
decision: Do not publish the original generated image; compare repeat-safe candidates in the actual renderer.
next: Judge stitched rich and bright candidates at close and chase views.
evidenceScope: Image-space comparison and diagnostics; no on-ship result for this iteration.
performance: A unique texture breaks sharing with the existing fleet atlas; actual GPU format and frame cost remain unmeasured.

action: Reviewed matched current-renderer close and chase screenshots for the original, rich, bright and bright-512 Lark source-GLB proxies.
observation: Rich added modest painted wear but made the cream slightly muddier; bright variants stayed close to the rejected baseline. At chase distance none supplied a meaningful improvement. Teal and silhouette remained; no obvious hard tile seam appeared in these views. This source-GLB preview bypasses the final mapped render package.
decision: Hold these candidates rather than incur additional storage for an essentially invisible change; a more substantial treatment is being prepared.
next: Review the stronger candidate at relevant angles and, if accepted, verify its actual package and ordinary loading path.
evidenceScope: Same-session isolated renderer comparison; no full gameplay acceptance or final package claim.
performance: Encoded candidate deltas and expected texture storage are documented in the asset worker's README; no live frame-time result.

variantCoverage.note: Fleet-look selects the finest declared LOD; source-GLB proxy, not gameplay/package acceptance.
